{{nihongo|'''Oyama Shrine (Tomika)'''|大山神社 (富加町)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Oyama Shrine''' (おおやまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tomika, Gifu|Q1203855|qid=Q1203855}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Gifu|Q1348656|qid=Q1348656}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=former shrine rank}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
; Principal deity 
*{{ill|Ōyamatsumi|Q386563|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamazumi-no-Kami}}

; Merged deities 
*{{ill|Takeminakata|lt=Takeminakata|Q402376|qid=Q402376|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata-no-Kami}}
*{{ill|Ukanomitama|de|Ukanomitama|eo|Ukanomitama|fr|Uka-no-Mitama|ja|ウカノミタマ|mni|ꯎꯀꯅꯣꯃꯤꯇꯃ|ru|Ука-но митама|simple|Ukanomitama|sv|Ukanomitama|th|อูกาโนมิตามะ|zh|宇迦之御魂神|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Kami}}
*{{ill|Wakumusubi|UNKNOWN|Wakumusubi|lt=Homusubi-no-Kami}}
*{{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}} 
*{{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|Q382005|qid=Q382005}}
*{{ill|Kikurihime|Q11619891|qid=Q11619891|lt=Kikurihime-no-Kami}}

=== History ===
There is a theory identifying it as Oyama Shrine in Kamo District, {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha register}}. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} it was reportedly called "Kamo Myōjin" and "Hakusan-gū."
